title_en: National Security Law of the People's Republic of China

articles.content_en: Article 1 This Law is enacted in accordance with the Constitution for the purpose of safeguarding national security, protecting the people's democratic dictatorship and the socialist system with Chinese characteristics, defending the fundamental interests of the people, ensuring the smooth progress of reform and opening up and socialist modernization, and realizing the great rejuvenation of the Chinese nation.

Article 2 National security refers to the relative state of absence of danger and freedom from internal and external threats to the state's regime, sovereignty, unity and territorial integrity, the well-being of the people, sustainable economic and social development, and other major state interests, as well as the capability to ensure a sustained state of security.

Article 3 National security work shall uphold a holistic approach to national security, with the purpose of protecting the security of the people, taking political security as the foundation, economic security as the base, military, cultural and social security as safeguards, and promoting international security as support, to safeguard national security in all areas, build a national security system, and follow a path of national security with Chinese characteristics.

Article 4 The leadership of the Communist Party of China over national security work shall be upheld, and a centralized, unified, efficient and authoritative national security leadership system shall be established.

Article 5 The central national security leadership body shall be responsible for decision-making and deliberation and coordination on national security work, researching and formulating national security strategies and relevant major policies and guidelines, guiding their implementation, coordinating major national security matters and important work, and promoting the construction of the rule of law in national security.

Article 6 The State shall formulate and continuously improve the national security strategy, comprehensively assess the international and domestic security situation, and define the guiding principles, medium- and long-term goals, national security policies in key areas, work tasks and measures of the national security strategy.

Article 7 In safeguarding national security, the Constitution and laws shall be observed, the principles of socialist rule of law shall be upheld, human rights shall be respected and guaranteed, and the rights and freedoms of citizens shall be protected according to law.

Article 8 Safeguarding national security shall be coordinated with economic and social development.
National security work shall take into overall consideration internal and external security, homeland and national security, traditional and non-traditional security, and one's own security and common security.

Article 9 In safeguarding national security, the principle of prevention first and addressing both symptoms and root causes shall be adhered to, and specialized work shall be combined with the mass line, giving full play to the functions and roles of specialized agencies and other relevant agencies in safeguarding national security, extensively mobilizing citizens and organizations to prevent, stop and lawfully punish acts endangering national security.

Article 10 In safeguarding national security, the principles of mutual trust, mutual benefit, equality and cooperation shall be adhered to, and security exchanges and cooperation with foreign governments and international organizations shall be actively conducted, international security obligations shall be fulfilled, common security shall be promoted, and world peace shall be maintained.

Article 11 Citizens of the People's Republic of China, all state organs and armed forces, all political parties and people's organizations, enterprises, public institutions and other social organizations, all have the responsibility and obligation to safeguard national security.
China's sovereignty and territorial integrity are inviolable and indivisible. Safeguarding national sovereignty, unity and territorial integrity is the common obligation of all Chinese people, including compatriots in Hong Kong, Macao and Taiwan.
Article 12 The State shall commend and reward individuals and organizations that make outstanding contributions in the work of safeguarding national security.

Article 13 Where state functionaries abuse their powers, neglect their duties or engage in malpractices for personal gain in national security work and activities involving national security, they shall be investigated for legal liability according to law.
Where any individual or organization violates this Law and relevant laws, fails to perform the obligation to safeguard national security or engages in activities endangering national security, they shall be investigated for legal liability according to law.
Article 14 April 15 of each year shall be the National Security Education Day.

Article 15 The State shall uphold the leadership of the Communist Party of China, maintain the socialist system with Chinese characteristics, develop socialist democratic politics, improve the socialist rule of law, strengthen the checks and oversight mechanisms on the exercise of power, and guarantee the rights of the people to be the masters of the country.
The State shall prevent, stop and lawfully punish any acts of treason, secession, incitement to rebellion, subversion or incitement to subvert the people's democratic dictatorship; prevent, stop and lawfully punish acts endangering national security such as stealing or divulging state secrets; and prevent, stop and lawfully punish infiltration, sabotage, subversion and secession activities by foreign forces.

Article 16 The State shall safeguard and develop the fundamental interests of the broadest majority of the people, protect the security of the people, create good conditions for survival and development and a stable working and living environment, and ensure the safety of life and property of citizens and their other lawful rights and interests.

Article 17 The State shall strengthen the construction of border, sea and air defense, take all necessary defensive and control measures to protect the security of the territorial land, internal waters, territorial sea and airspace, and safeguard national territorial sovereignty and maritime rights and interests.

Article 18 The State shall strengthen the armed forces in revolutionization, modernization and regularization, build armed forces that meet the needs of safeguarding national security and development interests; implement the military strategy of active defense, prevent and resist aggression, stop armed subversion and secession; conduct international military security cooperation, carry out military operations such as United Nations peacekeeping, international rescue, maritime escort and protection of national overseas interests, and safeguard national sovereignty, security, territorial integrity, development interests and world peace.

Article 19 The State shall maintain the basic economic system and the order of the socialist market economy, improve the institutional mechanisms for preventing and resolving economic security risks, and ensure the security of important industries and key areas related to the lifeline of the national economy, key industries, major infrastructure and major construction projects, as well as other major economic interests.

Article 20 The State shall improve the macro-prudential management of finance and the mechanisms for preventing and handling financial risks, strengthen the construction of financial infrastructure and basic capabilities, prevent and resolve systemic and regional financial risks, and prevent and resist the impact of external financial risks.

Article 21 The State shall rationally utilize and protect resources and energy, effectively manage and control the development of strategic resources and energy, strengthen the reserve of strategic resources and energy, improve the construction of strategic corridors for resource and energy transportation and safety protection measures, strengthen international cooperation on resources and energy, comprehensively improve emergency support capacity, and ensure the continuous, reliable and effective supply of resources and energy needed for economic and social development.

Article 22 The State shall improve the food security guarantee system, protect and enhance the comprehensive grain production capacity, improve the grain reserve system, distribution system and market regulation mechanism, improve the food security early warning system, and ensure the supply and quality safety of grain.

Article 23 The State shall adhere to the direction of advanced socialist culture, inherit and carry forward the excellent traditional culture of the Chinese nation, cultivate and practice the core socialist values, prevent and resist the influence of bad culture, maintain dominance in the ideological field, and enhance the overall strength and competitiveness of culture.

Article 24 The State shall strengthen the construction of independent innovation capability, accelerate the development of independent and controllable strategic high technology and core key technologies in important fields, strengthen the application and protection of intellectual property and the construction of science and technology confidentiality capability, and ensure the security of major technologies and projects.

Article 25 The State shall build a network and information security guarantee system, enhance the protection capability of network and information security, strengthen innovative research, development and application of network and information technology, achieve the security and controllability of core network and information technologies, key infrastructure and information systems and data in important fields; strengthen network management, prevent, stop and lawfully punish cyber crimes such as cyber attacks, cyber intrusions, cyber theft of secrets, and dissemination of illegal and harmful information, and safeguard national cyberspace sovereignty, security and development interests.

Article 26 The State shall uphold and improve the system of regional ethnic autonomy, consolidate and develop socialist ethnic relations of equality, solidarity, mutual assistance and harmony. Adhere to equality among all ethnic groups, strengthen ethnic contacts, exchanges and integration, prevent, stop and lawfully punish ethnic secession activities, safeguard national unity, ethnic solidarity and social harmony, and achieve common unity and struggle and common prosperity and development of all ethnic groups.

Article 27 The State shall protect citizens' freedom of religious belief and normal religious activities according to law, adhere to the principle of independence and self-management of religious affairs, prevent, stop and lawfully punish illegal and criminal activities that endanger national security in the name of religion, oppose interference by foreign forces in domestic religious affairs, and maintain the order of normal religious activities.
The State shall outlaw cult organizations according to law, and prevent, stop and lawfully punish illegal and criminal activities of cults.

Article 28 The State shall oppose all forms of terrorism and extremism, strengthen the capacity building for preventing and handling terrorism, carry out intelligence, investigation, prevention, handling and fund supervision work according to law, lawfully outlaw terrorist activity organizations and severely punish violent terrorist activities.

Article 29 The State shall improve the institutional mechanisms for effectively preventing and resolving social conflicts, improve the public safety system, actively prevent, reduce and resolve social conflicts, properly handle public health, social security and other emergencies affecting national security and social stability, promote social harmony, and maintain public safety and social stability.

Article 30 The State shall improve the system of ecological and environmental protection, increase the efforts of ecological construction and environmental protection, designate ecological protection red lines, strengthen early warning and prevention and control of ecological risks, properly handle environmental emergencies, ensure that the natural environment and conditions such as air, water and soil on which the people rely for survival and development are not threatened or damaged, and promote harmonious development between man and nature.

Article 31 The State shall adhere to the peaceful use of nuclear energy and nuclear technology, strengthen international cooperation, prevent nuclear proliferation, improve the non-proliferation mechanism, strengthen the safety management, supervision and protection of nuclear facilities, nuclear materials, nuclear activities and the disposal of nuclear waste, strengthen the nuclear accident emergency system and emergency response capacity, prevent, control and eliminate the harm of nuclear accidents to the life, health and ecological environment of citizens, and continuously enhance the capability to effectively respond to and prevent nuclear threats and nuclear attacks.

Article 32 The State shall adhere to the peaceful exploration and use of outer space, the international seabed area and the polar regions, enhance the capabilities of safe entry and exit, scientific investigation, development and utilization, strengthen international cooperation, and safeguard the security of China's activities, assets and other interests in outer space, the international seabed area and the polar regions.

Article 33 The State shall take necessary measures according to law to protect the safety and legitimate rights and interests of overseas Chinese citizens, organizations and institutions, and protect the country's overseas interests from threats and infringements.
Article 34 The State shall, according to the needs of economic and social development and national development interests, continuously improve the tasks of safeguarding national security.

Article 35 The National People's Congress shall, in accordance with the provisions of the Constitution, decide on issues of war and peace, and exercise other functions and powers concerning national security as provided for by the Constitution.
The Standing Committee of the National People's Congress shall, in accordance with the provisions of the Constitution, decide on the declaration of a state of war, decide on general mobilization or partial mobilization, decide on the entry into a state of emergency in the whole country or in individual provinces, autonomous regions or municipalities directly under the Central Government, and exercise other functions and powers concerning national security as provided for by the Constitution and as granted by the National People's Congress.

Article 36 The President of the People's Republic of China shall, in accordance with the decisions of the National People's Congress and the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress, declare a state of emergency, declare a state of war, issue mobilization orders, and exercise other functions and powers concerning national security as provided for by the Constitution.

Article 37 The State Council shall, in accordance with the Constitution and laws, formulate administrative regulations concerning national security, prescribe relevant administrative measures, issue relevant decisions and orders; implement national security laws, regulations and policies; decide, in accordance with the provisions of laws, on the entry into a state of emergency in parts of provinces, autonomous regions or municipalities directly under the Central Government; and exercise other functions and powers concerning national security as provided for by the Constitution and laws and as granted by the National People's Congress and its Standing Committee.

Article 38 The Central Military Commission shall lead the national armed forces, decide on military strategy and operational guidelines of the armed forces, uniformly command military operations to safeguard national security, formulate military regulations concerning national security, and issue relevant decisions and orders.

Article 39 The various departments of the central state organs shall, according to their respective functions and duties, implement national security principles, policies, laws and regulations, and manage and guide national security work in their own systems and fields.

Article 40 The local people's congresses at various levels and the standing committees of the local people's congresses at and above the county level shall, within their respective administrative areas, ensure the observance and implementation of national security laws and regulations.
Local people's governments at various levels shall manage national security work within their respective administrative areas according to laws and regulations.
The Hong Kong Special Administrative Region and the Macao Special Administrative Region shall fulfill the responsibility of safeguarding national security.

Article 41 The People's Courts shall exercise the adjudicative power in accordance with the provisions of laws, and the People's Procuratorates shall exercise the procuratorial power in accordance with the provisions of laws, to punish crimes endangering national security.

Article 42 The national security organs and public security organs shall collect intelligence information concerning national security according to law, and exercise the powers of investigation, detention, preliminary interrogation and execution of arrest, as well as other functions and powers provided for by law in national security work.
Relevant military organs shall exercise relevant functions and powers in national security work according to law.

Article 43 State organs and their functionaries shall, when performing their duties, implement the principle of safeguarding national security.
State organs and their functionaries shall strictly perform their duties according to law in national security work and activities involving national security, and shall not exceed or abuse their powers, and shall not infringe upon the lawful rights and interests of individuals and organizations.

Article 44 The central national security leadership body shall implement a national security system and working mechanism that combines unified and decentralized approaches and is coordinated and efficient.
Article 45 The State shall establish a work coordination mechanism for key areas of national security, and coordinate the relevant central functional departments to advance related work.

Article 46 The State shall establish a mechanism for supervision, inspection and accountability for national security work to ensure implementation of national security strategies and major deployments.
Article 47 All departments and regions shall take effective measures to implement the national security strategy.

Article 48 The State shall, based on the needs of safeguarding national security, establish a cross-departmental consultation and working mechanism to conduct consultations and studies on major matters of safeguarding national security, and put forward opinions and suggestions.

Article 49 The State shall establish a coordination and linkage mechanism on national security between the central and local authorities, among departments, between the military and local authorities, and among regions.

Article 50 The State shall establish a decision-making consultation mechanism for national security, organize experts and relevant parties to conduct analysis and assessment of the national security situation, and promote scientific decision-making on national security.

The State shall improve the system for the collection, assessment, and use of intelligence information that is unified under a single authority, responsive, accurate, efficient, and smoothly operating, establish a coordination mechanism for intelligence work, and achieve timely collection, accurate assessment, effective use, and sharing of intelligence information.

The State security organs, public security organs, and relevant military organs shall, according to their respective functions and duties, collect intelligence information concerning national security in accordance with law.
All departments of State organs shall, in the course of performing their duties, promptly report any information concerning national security that they obtain.

In carrying out intelligence work, modern scientific and technological means shall be fully utilized to strengthen the identification, screening, synthesis, assessment, and analysis of intelligence information.
The reporting of intelligence information shall be timely, accurate, and objective. No delayed reporting, omission, concealment, or false reporting shall be allowed.
The State shall formulate and improve contingency plans for addressing national security risks in various fields.

The State shall establish a national security risk assessment mechanism and conduct regular investigations and assessments of national security risks in various fields.
Relevant departments shall periodically submit national security risk assessment reports to the central national security leadership institution.
The State shall improve the national security risk monitoring and early warning system, and issue timely risk warnings according to the degree of national security risks.

For incidents that may imminently occur or have already occurred that endanger national security, the local people's governments at or above the county level and their relevant competent departments shall immediately report to the people's government at the next higher level and its relevant competent departments in accordance with regulations, and may, when necessary, report directly to the highest level.

The State shall establish systems and mechanisms for national security review and supervision, and conduct national security reviews on foreign investments, specific items and key technologies, network information technology products and services, construction projects involving national security matters, and other major matters and activities that affect or may affect national security, so as to effectively prevent and resolve national security risks.

All departments of the central State organs shall exercise the functions and duties of national security review in accordance with laws and administrative regulations, make national security review decisions or provide security review opinions according to law, and supervise their implementation.

The provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government shall be responsible for the relevant national security review and supervision work within their respective administrative regions according to law.
The State shall establish a system of national security crisis management and control that is under unified leadership, coordinated and linked, and orderly and efficient.

When a major incident endangering national security occurs, the relevant central departments and relevant local authorities shall, in accordance with the unified deployment of the central national security leadership institution, initiate emergency plans according to law and take measures for management, control, and handling.

When an especially major incident endangering national security occurs that requires entering a state of emergency, a state of war, or carrying out a national total mobilization or partial mobilization, the National People's Congress, the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress, or the State Council shall decide in accordance with the powers and procedures prescribed by the Constitution and relevant laws.

After a decision is made by the State to enter a state of emergency, a state of war, or to implement defense mobilization, the relevant organs performing the duties of national security crisis management and control shall, in accordance with legal provisions or the provisions of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress, have the authority to take special measures to restrict the rights of citizens and organizations and increase their obligations.

The relevant organs performing the duties of national security crisis management and control shall, when taking management and control measures to handle a national security crisis according to law, ensure that such measures are commensurate with the nature, degree, and extent of the harm that the national security crisis may cause; and if multiple measures are available, they shall choose the measure that is conducive to protecting the rights and interests of citizens and organizations to the greatest extent.

The State shall improve the information reporting and release mechanism for national security crises.
After a national security crisis incident occurs, the relevant organs performing the duties of national security crisis management and control shall report accurately and promptly in accordance with regulations, and shall uniformly release to the public, in accordance with law, information regarding the occurrence, development, management, control, handling, and follow-up of such national security crisis incident.
After national security threats and harms are controlled or eliminated, the management, control, and handling measures shall be promptly lifted, and follow-up work shall be properly carried out.
The State shall improve the national security guarantee system and enhance its capacity to safeguard national security.
The State shall improve the legal system for national security and promote the construction of the rule of law in national security.
The State shall increase investment in various aspects of national security construction and ensure the necessary funds and equipment for national security work.

The units undertaking the task of stockpiling strategic materials for national security shall, in accordance with the relevant regulations and standards of the State, procure, store, maintain, and periodically adjust and replace such materials to ensure the effectiveness and safety of the stockpiled materials.
Scientific and technological innovation in the field of national security shall be encouraged, and the role of science and technology in safeguarding national security shall be brought into play.

The State shall take necessary measures to recruit, train, and manage specialized and special talents for national security work.
In accordance with the needs of safeguarding national security, the State shall protect the identities and lawful rights and interests of personnel specifically engaged in national security work in relevant organs according to law, and strengthen personal protection and resettlement guarantees.

The State security organs, public security organs, and relevant military organs may, when carrying out specialized national security work, take necessary means and methods according to law, and the relevant departments and local authorities shall provide support and cooperation within their respective functions and duties.

The State shall strengthen news publicity and public opinion guidance on national security, carry out national security publicity and education activities through various forms, incorporate national security education into the national education system and the civil servant education and training system, and enhance the national security awareness of the whole people.

State organs, people's organizations, enterprises, public institutions, and other social organizations shall conduct education on safeguarding national security among their own personnel, and mobilize and organize their personnel to prevent and stop acts endangering national security.
Enterprises and public institutions shall, in accordance with the requirements of national security work, cooperate with relevant departments in taking relevant security measures.

The acts of citizens and organizations in supporting and assisting national security work shall be protected by law.
If the personal safety of themselves or their close relatives is endangered due to supporting or assisting national security work, they may request protection from the public security organs or the State security organs. The public security organs and the State security organs shall, together with relevant departments, take protective measures according to law.

If citizens and organizations suffer property losses due to supporting or assisting national security work, compensation shall be given in accordance with the relevant regulations of the State; if personal injury or death is caused, pension and preferential treatment shall be given in accordance with the relevant regulations of the State.

Citizens and organizations have the right to make criticisms and suggestions to State organs regarding national security work, and have the right to submit petitions, complaints, and reports against illegal or derelict acts of State organs and their staff in national security work.

When special measures need to be taken to restrict the rights and freedoms of citizens in national security work, such measures shall be taken according to law and shall be limited to the extent actually necessary for safeguarding national security.
This Law shall come into force as of the date of its promulgation.
